name: esb64
description: ESB64 — base64 (atob/btoa) polyfill + UTF-8 codec library for ExtendScript (ES3) engines

scripts.estc:static: node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESB64.jsx dist/vendor-esb64.js dist/ESB64-runtime.jsx dist/vendor-esb64-runtime.js dist/ESB64.facade.jsx dist/ESB64.accel.jsx dist/ESB64.accel.min.jsx --no-target
scripts.estc:live-parse: node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESB64.jsx dist/vendor-esb64.js dist/ESB64-runtime.jsx dist/vendor-esb64-runtime.js dist/ESB64.facade.jsx dist/ESB64.accel.jsx dist/ESB64.accel.min.jsx --no-target --live --launch
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build:accel && npm run test && npm run fuzz && npm run estc:static
scripts.release:gate: npm run verify && npm run estc:live-parse && npm run live-verify
scripts.verify:engine: npm run estc:live-parse && npm run live-verify
scripts.ci:local: npm run ci:static && npm run verify:engine
